notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Performance
[list]
[*] Added VSync. This should improve overall performance and prevent runaway GPU usage.
[*] If you turn VSync off, the game will now use a locked framerate instead of going unlimited.
[/list]
Content
[list]
[*] Upgrades & Tentacles: Increased overall power levels.
[*] New Wearable: Added a new type of wearable item in the vending machine.
[*] New Tentacle: Added a tentacle that deals increased damage against slowed targets.
[/list]
Balance
[list]
[*] Overall balance is still being tuned, feedback is very welcome as we continue finding the sweet spot.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content: KAISA: Resurrection is now available in Early Access! We welcome you in to explore this strange little game and please join our discord to leave your feedback and suggestions, we are all ears and are working on it constantly.

notes.title: Playtester takes on the new build
notes.content: Is the game balanced and fair? who knows.

notes.title: Developer Playthrough
notes.content: Join me as I attempt to finish my own demo. I will be trying to make it all the way to the final boss while sharing insights into the game’s development, mechanics, and hidden secrets.
